versions.subject: Update detection
versions.detection:
selection_exe:
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'cscript.exe'
        - 'wscript.exe'
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
selection_script:
    CommandLine|contains: '.vbs'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName IN ("cscript.exe", "wscript.exe") OR Image IN ("*\\cscript.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") CommandLine="*.vbs*"
